evidenceMethod: Temporary test-entry copies of one signed packaged app; unchanged retained production archive and native runtime. Lifecycle smoke dispatch and audit are instrumented; --verified leaves runtime capability unchanged. Candidate had renderer-only incremental repacks with outer signature metadata preserved, after a full release package build.

limitations: Process-scoped controlled DoH and synthetic certificate trust are probe instrumentation. Chromium DoH resolver liveness traffic is retained separately and correlated by TCP source port, never timestamp-only inference. Literal-IP early-teardown navigation phases disable only the probe-process DoH resolver. Default OS DNS path is not independently captured.
Remote capture covers configured IPv4 endpoint and TURN relay ports; IPv6 external routing is unavailable on this endpoint.
Loopback IPv4/IPv6 transport uses independent local listener accepts rather than privileged macOS BPF capture.
